transport: transformers, local weights, full vocabulary, single forward pass
why_this_exists: Ollama top-K failed certification, gemma4:e2b omits logprobs at sentence boundaries, and llama.cpp cannot load the Gemma 4 GGUF; all three re-tested 2026-07-25. Taking logits directly avoids all three.
rule: accept when s_band[0] <= S <= s_band[1] and R >= r_floor and E >= e_floor; SCOPE: frame hints only from trusted provenance, per the frame-provenance finding in native_format_probe.json

what_this_establishes.transport: SOLVED. Gemma 4 now yields exact full-vocabulary teacher-forced NLL. All five reference cases returned measured=true with no top-K censoring, no serving-layer prompt rewriting, and no lower-bound clipping. The three prior receipts (Ollama top-K certification failure, e2b EOS omission, llama.cpp architecture rejection) were transport limits, and taking logits directly removes all three.
what_this_establishes.certification: FAILED on this variant. Two of the three reference jokes resolve at R = 0.000 and 0.007, so min(joke R) does not exceed max(control R). Gemma 4 E2B does not reconstruct the speed-bumps or lion-heart frames the way gemma-2-2b-it does, and an instrument that cannot separate a joke from a boring line is not allowed to gate acceptance here, regardless of how current the model is.
what_this_establishes.why_S_is_not_comparable_to_gemma2: S is a per-token NLL under a different tokenizer and vocabulary, so 9.191 here and 3.19 on gemma-2 are not the same quantity and must never be compared directly. Each instrument derives its own band or it is not an instrument.
what_this_establishes.control_separation_is_structurally_trivi: Both controls carry an empty frame, and compute_signals returns R = 0 by construction when no frame is supplied. So 'controls fail' is a property of the protocol, not a measurement. A meaningful control arm must give the controls a frame and require the null to absorb it. Logged as the next fix rather than counted as evidence here.
what_this_establishes.next_lever: try a larger Gemma 4 (E4B or 12B) before concluding the family cannot serve as the instrument; E2B is the smallest variant and was chosen for CPU affordability, not for measurement quality.
